+- name: events
+  description: Releases and maintainer annotations used for association comparisons.
+  model: ref('dim_event')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: event_date
+  entities:
+  - name: event
+    type: primary
+    expr: event_id
+  - name: repository
+    type: foreign
+    expr: repository
+  dimensions:
+  - name: event_date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  - name: kind
+    type: categorical
+  - name: title
+    type: categorical
+  - name: prerelease
+    type: categorical
+  measures:
+  - name: events_measure
+    agg: count
+    expr: event_id
+    description: Published releases and annotations dated in the period.
+- name: fct_star_history
+  description: Star history from the dates current stargazers starred the repository.
+  model: ref('fct_star_history')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: date
+  entities:
+  - name: star_history_row
+    type: primary
+    expr: star_history_key
+  - name: repository
+    type: foreign
+    expr: repository
+  dimensions:
+  - name: date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  measures:
+  - name: stars_gained_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: stars_gained
+    description: Current stargazers who starred in the period. Unstars are invisible, so
+      history counts only people who still star the repository.
+- name: fct_fork_history
+  description: Fork history from the creation dates of existing direct forks.
+  model: ref('fct_fork_history')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: date
+  entities:
+  - name: fork_history_row
+    type: primary
+    expr: fork_history_key
+  - name: repository
+    type: foreign
+    expr: repository
+  dimensions:
+  - name: date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  measures:
+  - name: forks_created_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: forks_created
+    description: Existing direct forks created in the period; deleted forks are invisible.
+- name: fct_issues
+  description: Issue and pull request activity without titles, bodies, or author identities.
+  model: ref('fct_issues')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: created_date
+  entities:
+  - name: issue
+    type: primary
+    expr: issue_key
+  - name: repository
+    type: foreign
+    expr: repository
+  dimensions:
+  - name: created_date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  - name: closed_date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  - name: merged_date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  - name: kind
+    type: categorical
+  - name: author_association
+    type: categorical
+  measures:
+  - name: issues_opened_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: case when kind = 'issue' then 1 else 0 end
+    description: Issues opened in the period (excludes pull requests).
+  - name: issues_closed_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: case when kind = 'issue' and closed_date is not null then 1 else 0 end
+    agg_time_dimension: closed_date
+    description: Issues closed in the period, by close date (excludes pull requests).
+  - name: prs_opened_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: case when kind = 'pull_request' then 1 else 0 end
+    description: Pull requests opened in the period.
+  - name: prs_merged_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: case when merged_date is not null then 1 else 0 end
+    agg_time_dimension: merged_date
+    description: Pull requests merged in the period, by merge date.
+  - name: first_time_contributor_prs_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: case when kind = 'pull_request' and is_first_time_contributor then 1 else 0 end
+    description: Pull requests whose author GitHub marked as a first-time contributor when
+      collection first saw them. Backfilled history undercounts.
+  - name: hours_to_merge_measure
+    agg: percentile
+    expr: hours_to_merge
+    agg_time_dimension: merged_date
+    agg_params:
+      percentile: 0.5
+      use_discrete_percentile: false
+    description: Median hours from opening to merge for pull requests merged in the period.
+- name: fct_release_downloads
+  description: GitHub release asset download balances captured by collection.
+  model: ref('fct_release_downloads')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: date
+  entities:
+  - name: release_download_row
+    type: primary
+    expr: release_download_key
+  - name: repository
+    type: foreign
+    expr: repository
+  - name: event
+    type: foreign
+    expr: event_id
+  dimensions:
+  - name: date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  measures:
+  - name: release_downloads_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: download_count
+    description: Cumulative release asset downloads at the last capture in each bucket,
+      separately per repository. Not unique users or installations.
+    non_additive_dimension:
+      name: date
+      window_choice: max
+      window_groupings:
+      - repository
+  - name: release_downloads_net_change_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: downloads_net_change
+    description: Release asset download change between consecutive daily captures; gaps
+      and initial captures are null.
+- name: fct_package_downloads
+  description: Optional package-registry downloads (PyPI via pypistats, npm via the npm API).
+  model: ref('fct_package_downloads')
+  defaults:
+    agg_time_dimension: date
+  entities:
+  - name: package_download
+    type: primary
+    expr: package_download_key
+  - name: repository
+    type: foreign
+    expr: repository
+  dimensions:
+  - name: date
+    type: time
+    type_params:
+      time_granularity: day
+  - name: registry
+    type: categorical
+  - name: package
+    type: categorical
+  measures:
+  - name: package_downloads_measure
+    agg: sum
+    expr: downloads
+    description: Registry downloads reported for the period; includes CI and bots, PyPI
+      excludes mirrors. Not installations or users.
 metrics:
 - name: views
   label: Views

+  type_params:
+    measure: release_downloads_measure
